summary: Sanders County crowsnest on Kootenai NF: firelookout.com dates a log cabin to 1934 and says destroyed 1948; other lists say abandoned or removed.

facts.design: log cabin with a crow's nest (firelookout.com); the FFLA list types it as a crowsnest
facts.status_note: Destroyed 1948 per firelookout.com; FFLA lists it as abandoned and montanalookouts as removed; no source describes the site today

events.note: June 1931 Sanders County Independent-Ledger notice, quoted on montanalookouts, names Ralph Flemming as lookout again that year; three years before the 1934 build date on firelookout.com
log cabin with a crow's nest, per firelookout.com; the 1931 staffing notice points to an earlier lookout
firelookout.com says destroyed 1948; the Montana page says removed and the FFLA list says abandoned, both undated

evidence.supports: built 1934 as a log cabin with a crow's nest; destroyed 1948
June 1931 notice says Ralph Flemming will be lookout again that year
evidence.quote: Ralph Flemming will be lookout on Fatman again this year.

evidence.supports: the 1931 notice is from the Sanders County Independent-Ledger

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com dates the cabin to 1934, but a June 1931 notice names a lookout on Fatman; the story gives both and does not pick one
firelookout.com says destroyed 1948, the Montana page says removed and the FFLA list says abandoned; the story reports all three without merging them

notes_for_editor: Only three thin pages (two one-line firelookout.com and montanalookouts entries, plus the FFLA list row). Build date and fate disagree across sources, and the 1931 staffing notice predates the 1934 build date. No NRHP, Forest Service or newspaper-archive record was reached. The records place the site at 48.10209, -115.98305; access is unknown.
